# `∞` — Infinity

`∞` and `¯∞` are approximate real infinities.

```apl
∞+3                ⍝ ∞
3÷∞                ⍝ 0
⌊/⍬                ⍝ ∞
⌈/⍬                ⍝ ¯∞
```

`¯∞` < every finite real < `∞`. Each infinity equals itself. Empty min/max identities are infinite even for exact arrays.

DOMAIN: `∞-∞`, `0×∞`, `∞÷∞`, non-finite complex results, infinite indices/counts.
